ITEM 1 | Yellow grains with a loose, granular texture, pale golden to saffron-yellow with some darker bits and small orange flecks, dry-looking and separate, forming a mound about 10 cm across and 1.5 cm thick on the left side of the plate | 150
ITEM 2 | Dark green leafy greens with glossy, slightly wilted leaves and pale green stems, some leaves folded and clumped, covering roughly a 10 cm by 9 cm area on the right side of the plate with moderate moisture and a slight sheen | 90
